posts.author: ahgu
posts.content_md:
I don't know how Rallisson did his pin coating. I cannot get uniform coating with DCG. See picture below. 

solution about 5-25-120. Temp 40-50C. veil coat it first then spin at 80RPM Under regular light, it is very obvious it is not even. 

![coating2.jpg](https://holographyforum.org/forum/download/file.php?id=7047)

I also tried mold coating. Looks good until developing, Get those circular flow pattern left after developing. Shim is about 50um. Final dried thickness about 7-8um thick. 

![coating3.jpg](https://holographyforum.org/forum/download/file.php?id=7048)

Also tried Meyer bar, first try left thread mark, heat it up, no more thread mark, but uneven. 

DCG solution is pretty thick even at 50C, it is very resistant to flow. I wonder how you guys get it to flow uniformly.

posts.author: ahgu
posts.content_md:
The white is another issue. I suspect the cause was 

1. the solution was not overnighted. 

2. Did not wash out all the D after fixer. 

I suspect 1 might be main cause. The gelatin needs time to form better bonds. Correct me if wrong.

posts.author: holomaker
posts.content_md:
When mold coating do not force dry it at all, otherwise 

You may be sealing in moisture, don’t heat plates prior

To coating more than “just warm”, what thickness 

Shim are u using , possibly films to thick to harden through out causing milky....
